title: Engineering Reliable RAG Systems: Beyond Vector Search
summary: A practical breakdown of document chunking, embedding selection, retrieval quality, context construction, caching and hallucination evaluation. Explain how each stage affects the reliability of a domain-specific AI assistant.

title: Evaluating Fraud Detection Models Under Extreme Class Imbalance
summary: Explore why accuracy can be misleading in fraud detection, how SMOTE and undersampling change the training distribution, and how PR-AUC, F1-score and decision thresholds help assess minority-class performance.

title: Building Safer LLM Agents Through Systematic Evaluation
summary: Discuss how to characterize agent failure modes, test adversarial inputs, investigate hallucinations and turn qualitative observations into repeatable evaluation procedures.
